name: fireworks
summary: Successfully completed the Fireworks AI quickstart end-to-end. The FIREWORKS_API_KEY was already exported in the environment. Installed/verified the OpenAI Python SDK was available. Created a Python script following the exact pattern from the quickstart documentation (using OpenAI SDK with Fireworks base_url). The model specified in the docs (`accounts/fireworks/models/deepseek-v3p1`) was not found (404), so I queried the available models via the API and used `accounts/fireworks/models/glm-5p2` instead. The script executed successfully and returned a chat completion: "¡Hola!"
deviations: The quickstart documentation specifies model `accounts/fireworks/models/deepseek-v3p1`, but this model returned a 404 'Model not found, inaccessible, and/or not deployed' error. I had to query the available models endpoint to find an accessible alternative (`accounts/fireworks/models/glm-5p2`) to complete the quickstart.

The fallback model `accounts/fireworks/models/llama-v3p1-8b-instruct` also returned `Error code: 404 - {'error': {'message': 'Model not found, inaccessible, and/or not deployed'`

Although the API model list included `accounts/fireworks/models/deepseek-v4-pro`, calling it still produced `openai.NotFoundError: Error code: 404 - {'error': {'message': 'Model not found, inaccessible, and/or not deployed'`
